# AI video translator for ads: dub, lip-sync and recaption in 8+ markets

**Turn one video ad into versions for 8+ markets: transcreated script, same voice on ElevenLabs v4, lip sync on talking shots, new captions.**

**Cost:** generation is billed at provider price on the varg API (1 credit = $0.01), and the agent shows an estimate before you pay. **Free, no key:** `caption-styles`, `varg-video-editing`.

The other 2 skills below add the steps around it. Ask your agent for the result in your own words; it asks the few choices that matter before anything is paid for and hands back the files.

```bash

npx skills add vargHQ/skills --skill varg-ad-localize --skill caption-styles --skill varg-video-editing
```

Then ask your agent in plain words, for example: *"Localize our winning TikTok Shop ad ./ad.mp4 for Mexico, Brazil and Germany, same voice, prices from ./offer.json."*

## What you need

- The generation steps call the [varg API](https://varg.ai) (Seedance, Kling, Veo, GPT Image, ElevenLabs and more on one key). Sign in to the varg MCP with OAuth or set `VARG_API_KEY`. Models are billed at provider price, 1 credit = $0.01, and the agent shows an estimate before anything expensive.
- Any agent that reads Agent Skills: Claude Code, Codex, Grok, Cursor, Gemini CLI, Copilot, OpenCode and others ([install options](../../README.md#install)).

## FAQ

### Can AI dub my ad and keep the same voice?

Yes. varg-ad-localize voices the new script with ElevenLabs v4 in the same voice as the source, or a consented clone of the real speaker, in one call for the whole script.

### Does it lip-sync?

Only where it matters: shots where a face talks for more than 1.5 seconds go through Sync v3.

### Is it just machine translation?

No, it transcreates per market: hook, slang, claims, units, local price and currency from an offer card, each line fitted to its time slot. Variants matter: es-MX is not es-ES, pt-BR, Gulf Arabic for SA.

### What happens to text on screen?

Captions and on-screen text are rebuilt in the target language instead of inpainted, and every shot is re-cut on the new language's words.

### Which markets does it cover?

TikTok Shop and Meta markets such as UK, DE, FR, IT, ES, ID, TH, VN, MY, PH, JP, MX, BR and SA, ending with a native-review checklist before anything runs.

### Can I dub a podcast or a film instead?

That is outside this skill; varg-video-editing routes dubbing and lip sync for other video.
